title: Professional Verification Tools Schema
description: Comprehensive toolkit for verifying professional credentials, resumes, and backgrounds across ANY profession using free APIs and OSINT techniques

tools.name: parse_resume
tools.description: Parse resume/CV document and extract structured data including name, contact info, skills, education, and experience. Supports PDF, DOCX, TXT formats. Works for ANY profession.

file_path.description: Absolute path to resume file (PDF, DOCX, or TXT)

returns.name: string - Candidate name
returns.ai_detection: object - AI content analysis {is_ai_generated, confidence, indicators}

tools.name: extract_contact_info
tools.description: Extract all contact information from resume text: emails, phone numbers, LinkedIn, GitHub, personal websites. Uses regex pattern matching.

tools.name: analyze_skills_match
tools.description: Compare resume skills against job requirements and calculate match percentage. Works across all professions by analyzing keyword overlap and semantic similarity.

tools.name: verify_github_profile
tools.description: Verify GitHub profile exists and extract activity metrics: repositories, contributions, languages, star counts. Free API, 5000 requests/hour. Works for tech professionals.

tools.name: analyze_github_code_quality
tools.description: Analyze code quality metrics from GitHub repositories: code review participation, commit messages, documentation, test coverage indicators. For technical verification.

tools.name: cross_reference_github_resume
tools.description: Cross-reference GitHub activity timeline with resume work history. Detects inconsistencies like claimed employment during GitHub inactivity periods.

work_history.description: Resume work history entries with dates

tools.name: check_github_commit_authenticity
tools.description: Analyze commit patterns to detect fake commits, bulk imports, or contribution padding. Checks commit timestamps, file changes, and commit messages.

tools.name: verify_github_organization_membership
tools.description: Verify claimed company affiliations by checking GitHub organization memberships. Confirms if candidate was part of organization repositories.

tools.name: check_domain_age
tools.description:
Check domain registration age using WHOIS lookup. Helps verify company legitimacy - new domains may indicate fake companies. FREE (rate-limited). 

**AI INTERPRETATION REQUIRED:** 
- age_days < 180 (6 months) = 🚨 HIGH RISK: Very new company, possible fraud
- age_days 180-730 (6mo-2yr) = ⚠️ MODERATE RISK: Newer company, verify thoroughly
- age_days > 730 (2+ years) = ✅ ESTABLISHED: Legitimate timeline

**AI RESPONSE FORMAT:** 'Domain registered [date] ([age] old). Risk level: [HIGH/MODERATE/LOW]. [Interpretation]' 
**DO NOT** return raw JSON. Interpret the risk for the user.

tools.name: check_wayback_history
tools.description: Check Internet Archive Wayback Machine for historical snapshots of company website. Verifies company existed during claimed employment period. FREE unlimited.

returns.active_during_period: boolean - Website existed in date range

tools.name: verify_email_deliverability
tools.description: Verify email address exists and is deliverable using Hunter.io API. Checks MX records, mailbox existence. FREE tier: 50 requests/month.

returns.sources: array - Where email was found online

tools.name: check_company_data
tools.description: Fetch company information using Clearbit API: employee count, industry, location, social profiles. FREE tier: 100 requests/month.

tools.name: search_company_social_media
tools.description: Search for company presence on social media platforms (LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook). Verifies legitimate companies have social footprint.

tools.name: search_linkedin_profile
tools.description: Search for LinkedIn profile using Computer Use. Extracts job history, skills, endorsements, connections. Uses Anthropic Computer Use for automated browsing.

tools.name: cross_platform_timeline
tools.description: Build unified timeline from LinkedIn, GitHub, Twitter activity. Detects inconsistencies across platforms and validates work history.

returns.verified_claims: array - Claims confirmed by multiple sources

tools.name: analyze_social_media_authenticity
tools.description: Analyze social media profiles for signs of fake accounts: recent creation, few connections, generic posts, bot activity.

tools.name: google_dork_search
tools.description: Perform targeted Google searches using Computer Use to find mentions of candidate online: publications, news articles, forum posts, etc.

tools.name: verify_credential_registry
tools.description: Verify professional credentials against official registries using Computer Use. Supports: Medical (AHPRA, GMC), Legal (Bar Associations), Finance (CPA, CFA), Engineering (PE licenses), etc.

tools.name: check_education_credentials
tools.description: Verify university degrees and education credentials. Searches university registries, alumni databases, and accreditation records using Computer Use.
tools.example_usage: check_education_credentials(institution_name='MIT', degree_type='Bachelor', field_of_study='Computer Science', graduation_year='2018', candidate_name='John Doe')

tools.name: verify_certification
tools.description: Verify professional certifications (PMP, AWS, CPA, etc.) against issuing body databases. Uses Computer Use to search certification registries.
tools.example_usage: verify_certification(certification_name='AWS Solutions Architect', candidate_name='Jane Doe', issuing_body='Amazon Web Services')

tools.name: check_data_breach_exposure
tools.description: Check if email has been exposed in data breaches using Have I Been Pwned API. Security risk indicator. FREE unlimited.

tools.name: build_verification_timeline
tools.description: Aggregate all verification data into chronological timeline. Identifies gaps, overlaps, and inconsistencies in work/education history.

tools.name: calculate_verification_risk_score
tools.description:
Calculate overall risk score (0-100) based on all verification findings. Combines inconsistencies, red flags, and unverified claims into single metric.

**AI INTERPRETATION REQUIRED:**
- Score 0-25 = ✅ LOW RISK: Recommend proceeding with hire. Minor or no concerns.
- Score 26-50 = ⚠️ MEDIUM RISK: Recommend additional verification or reference checks before proceeding.
- Score 51-75 = 🚨 HIGH RISK: Significant concerns. Recommend rejection unless role is low-sensitivity and concerns can be fully resolved.
- Score 76-100 = 🚨 CRITICAL RISK: Strong recommend rejection. Multiple serious red flags.

**AI RESPONSE FORMAT:** 'Overall verification risk score: [score]/100 - [RISK LEVEL]. Recommendation: [PROCEED/ADDITIONAL VERIFICATION/REJECT]. Key concerns: [list top 3 issues]. Verified claims: [count]'
**CRITICAL:** Explain which specific findings drove the score up. One sex offender hit = instant 100. Multiple small inconsistencies ≠ same as criminal record.

tools.name: run_osint_sherlock
tools.description: Run Sherlock tool to find social media accounts across 300+ platforms. Uses username to discover online presence. Requires Sherlock installed.

tools.name: analyze_digital_footprint
tools.description: Comprehensive digital footprint analysis. Combines all OSINT data to create complete online presence map.

tools.name: check_criminal_records_public
tools.description:
Search public criminal records databases using Computer Use. Searches court records, sex offender registries, and public legal databases. Works for USA, Australia, UK, Canada.

**AI INTERPRETATION REQUIRED:**
- records_found=false + risk_level='Clear' = ✅ PASS: No criminal history found
- records_found=true + risk_level='Low' (minor charges, old records) = ⚠️ REVIEW: Assess relevance to position
- records_found=true + risk_level='High/Critical' (violence, fraud, sex crimes) = 🚨 FAIL: Serious concerns, recommend rejection
- sex_offender_registry=true = 🚨 AUTOMATIC DISQUALIFICATION for most positions

**AI RESPONSE FORMAT:** '[PASS/REVIEW/FAIL] Criminal records check: [Clear/Found]. [Details if found]. Risk: [level]. Recommendation: [specific action]'
**CRITICAL:** Always explain WHY the record matters for the specific role. A 20-year-old DUI is different from recent fraud charges for an accountant.

tools.name: check_court_records
tools.description: Search public court records for civil and criminal cases using Computer Use. Checks federal, state, and county court systems.
tools.example_usage: check_court_records(full_name='Jane Doe', state_province='New York', country='USA', case_type='both')

tools.name: check_sex_offender_registry
tools.description:
Check national and state sex offender registries. Critical for positions involving children, vulnerable adults. USA, Australia, UK registries supported. FREE.

**AI INTERPRETATION REQUIRED:**
- found_on_registry=false = ✅ PASS: Clear for all positions
- found_on_registry=true = 🚨 AUTOMATIC DISQUALIFICATION for education, healthcare, childcare, elder care roles. SERIOUS RED FLAG for ANY position.

**AI RESPONSE FORMAT:** If found: '🚨 CRITICAL: Candidate found on sex offender registry. AUTOMATIC DISQUALIFICATION. Do not proceed with hiring.' If clear: '✅ Sex offender registry: Clear. No concerns.'
**LEGAL NOTICE:** Many jurisdictions legally prohibit hiring registered sex offenders for certain roles. This is a ZERO-TOLERANCE finding.

tools.name: check_professional_sanctions
tools.description: Check for professional sanctions, disciplinary actions, and license revocations across medical, legal, financial, and other professional boards.

tools.name: check_bankruptcy_records
tools.description: Search federal and state bankruptcy court records. Important for financial positions or fiduciary roles. Uses PACER (USA) or equivalent systems.

tools.name: check_terrorist_watchlist
tools.description: Check international terrorist watchlists and sanctions lists (OFAC, UN, EU, Interpol). Critical for government, defense, finance sectors. FREE public APIs.

tools.name: check_interpol_red_notices
tools.description: Check Interpol Red Notices database for international arrest warrants. FREE public API access to Interpol notices.

tools.name: verify_identity_documents
tools.description: Verify identity documents (passport, driver's license, national ID) using Computer Use with OCR and document authentication checks.

tools.name: comprehensive_background_check
tools.description: Run comprehensive background check combining criminal records, court cases, sanctions, bankruptcy, watchlists, and identity verification. Single tool for complete screening.
tools.example_usage: comprehensive_background_check(full_name='John Doe', date_of_birth='1985-03-15', state_province='California', country='USA', profession='healthcare', check_level='comprehensive')
